segmented_sections.summary:
Final-year undergraduate at the University of Moratuwa with a strong foundation in software quality assurance, test
automation, and software testing methodologies. Experienced in designing and executing test cases, identifying de-
fects, and supporting CI/CD-driven development environments to ensure reliable software delivery. Detail-oriented,
analytical, and proactive, with a passion for improving software quality through effective testing practices. Eager to
apply technical knowledge and problem-solving skills in a QA role while continuously learning modern testing tools,
automation frameworks, and industry best practices.
